description:
The current Rust item store. What is purchasable in Rust's item store right now, in the three sections the wiki shows: `limited_time`
(this week's rotation, most Workshop subscribers first), `general` (the permanent catalogue) and `dlc_packs`
(bundles, by name). Each item carries `itemdefid`, `name`, `icon_url`, `category`, `store_price` (cents),
`market_price` (its Steam Community Market price in cents, null when unlisted), `rarity`, `item_collection`,
`creator_name`/`creator_avatar_url`, `subscriptions`, `est_supply` with `est_supply_source` (`workshop`
subscribers for brand-new items, the market estimate otherwise), `base_item_name` and the usual flags. Also
`recent_rotations` (the last six, newest first, `is_current` marks the open one), `active_rotation_id` and
`next_rotation_at` (the open rotation's start + 7 days; rotations land on Thursdays). Steam's own purchase URL
for any item is `https://store.steampowered.com/buyitem/252490/{itemdefid}/{quantity}`. Cached 30 minutes.
name: get_item_store
title: The current Rust item store
